title: Tansuo t01: Follow a Tap into a Chip

林工.reference_text: Hi, I'm Lin. Ready to see what's really inside?

阿凯.reference_text: Hey, I'm Kai! Wait — we're going in there?

shots.title: 城市错觉拉远
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...A city? Like looking down from a plane at night?

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...No way. This is a chip?

shots.title: 芯片特写
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；后期小字：数量举例：2023 年 A17 Pro，190 亿晶体管；不是画中无品牌样品的实测。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: A chip this small can hold nineteen billion switches? That's more than two for every person on Earth. But even with my eye practically touching it, I can't see a single one.

shots.title: 晶体管定义
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: It's true. These tiny switches are called transistors. A chip is a tiny slice packed with enormous numbers of them.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Okay... I'll believe half of that for now.

shots.title: 点击手机
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: See? One tap, and it lights up. But what's actually happening in there when I tap?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Let's follow that tap inside and find one of the switches it flips.

shots.title: 缩小规则
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；后期标注：缩小旅行／信号放慢为叙事示意；一次点击涉及许多器件，并非只拨动一个开关。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Each click makes us ten times smaller. We'll shrink to see the switches, then magnify the view to see atoms.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Hang on. How small are we talking? I'm not ready for this—

shots.title: 米粒与头发
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Whoa, that grain of rice is like a mountain. And that cliff next to it... don't tell me that's a hair.

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: It's a hair, about 80 to 100 micrometers thick. Follow that blue-white light. That's your tap.

shots.title: 黑色封装
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: That black block is the chip, right? It looks more like a chip than anything else on the board.

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Close. That's the package, basically its protective case. The actual chip is the thin slice of silicon inside.

shots.title: 焊球大厅
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Whoa, it's like an underground parking garage. What are all these shiny balls for, and why are there so many?

shots.title: 焊球连接
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Those are solder balls, the doorways between the chip and the motherboard. Power comes in through them, and signals go in and out.

shots.title: 供电接地与数据
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: We need so many to supply power, complete circuits, and carry data—not just to connect different parts.

shots.title: 封装爆炸分解
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Oh, it's opening up. So this thin gray slice is the actual chip? Why is it lying face-down?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: It's mounted upside down. The side with switches and wiring faces the motherboard, and that's where power and signals go in and out.

shots.title: 硅片翻转
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Then we need to flip it over.

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Okay, let's flip it so we can see. Just to be clear, a real chip doesn't do that.

shots.title: 硅片城市
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: It really does look like a city from a plane. Which part is the CPU?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: This is the CPU. Let's skip the other names and focus on what these regions share: the switches at the bottom.

shots.title: 颜色是后加的
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: But honestly, you couldn't tell these regions apart from up here. We added these colors ourselves.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Wait, you added them?

shots.title: 开关在哪个区
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: So which area has the switches?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: All these areas run on transistors. Different components and connections do different jobs.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Then why haven't I seen a single one since we got here?

shots.title: 开关在最底下
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch2.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；短角标：层间介质隐藏显示 / Dielectric hidden；层间黑色并非真实空气大厅。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Because they're at the very bottom, under more than a dozen layers of wiring. Let's head down.

shots.title: 导线城市
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；首次进结构层上屏：多种先进工艺的结构示例，非同一型号复刻 / Examples from different processes; not one chip teardown。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: All these layers look like highway overpasses. These must be the switches, right?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Nope, these are wires, mostly copper. There are more than a dozen layers.

shots.title: 上粗下细
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Up top, long, thick routes carry power and signals like highways. Below, short, narrow connections near the switches form crowded alleys.

shots.title: 层间绝缘与通孔
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Insulating material separates the layers, so crossing wires don't short out. Neighboring layers often run in different directions to make routing easier. Short posts connect the layers where needed.

shots.title: 信号与电子
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Look at that light go. It just zipped around the corner. The electrons must be racing through there, right?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: See those little orange dots in the wire? Those are the electrons. They don't travel along with that light.

shots.title: 电子只挪一点
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: The electrons jiggle in place and drift slightly. The electric field carries that push forward much faster.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Oh, like a packed subway: everyone shifts a little. But electric fields, not collisions, carry the change, which takes time.

shots.title: 拍糊了
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: I have to get a picture of this... Huh? Why is it all blurry? Come on, focus!

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Your phone isn't the problem. Light itself is too blunt a tool for this.

shots.title: 光的波长太粗
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Visible light spans 400 to 700 nanometers. Here, neighboring wire and transistor features have center-to-center spacing of tens of nanometers, so ordinary optical microscopes struggle to resolve them. More magnification won't help.

shots.title: 电子显微镜灰图示意
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Engineers use electron microscopes here, and the raw pictures are gray. We added colors to the chip's materials so we can tell them apart.

shots.title: 全灰了
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...Whoa, it's all gray. So that's an electron-microscope image. Like an old photograph.

shots.title: 抵达栅极阵列
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Finally, the bottom. Hey, people always talk about three nanometers. Which part is three nanometers, these walls or the gaps between them?

shots.title: 栅极中心间距
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；标尺：栅极中心距约 50 nm，仅为一种工艺示例；线宽、缝宽不能代替中心距。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: In one advanced process, these walls are called gates. Their centers are about 50 nanometers apart, so 1,600 to 2,000 gates could fit side by side across one hair.

shots.title: 工艺代号
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；短字卡：工艺代号 ≠ 单一尺寸 / Process name ≠ one dimension。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: So don't expect to measure three nanometers with a ruler here. It's a process name, like a car model. It doesn't match any single edge.

shots.title: 发现一个开关
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: This is a switch? Shouldn't a switch have some kind of handle? But nothing's moving. How does it turn on and off?

shots.title: 纳米片结构
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；模型切换卡：纳米片晶体管示意 / Nanosheet transistor example；不宣称开场 A17 Pro 使用环绕栅。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Picture an advanced nanosheet switch. Three or four super-thin silicon sheets, each about six nanometers thick, connect the two ends. The gate wraps around every sheet.

shots.title: 继电器对比
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: That handle you want? Some early computers did have something like that. They used relays. Apply power, and an electromagnet pulls a piece of iron over. Click—the contacts touch.

shots.title: 没有机械零件
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: But here, not a single part moves.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: No mechanical parts move at all... Does it still count as a switch?

shots.title: 关态
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；屏幕仅显示短角标：增强型 N 沟道示例 / Enhancement-mode nMOS。制作要求（不上屏）：这里的栅压均相对源极；源漏已有电势差，栅压控制通道；电子来自源漏载流子库，不画成绝缘层漏进来的电子。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: This N-type transistor is normally off. Why?

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: But with no gate voltage, doesn't silicon still have electrons?

shots.title: 断的是通道不是材料
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch2.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: It does, but they haven't formed a channel connecting the two ends. So right now, it's off.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: So the silicon stays. It's the path that's missing, not the material?

shots.title: 不是铺实体路
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_mechanism.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；本轮首帧采用统一纵向与横向结构示意；硅连续、绝缘层贴合、栅四面包围，载流子只在硅内；非实测尺寸。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Right. We're not building a physical road. The silicon stays in place. More electrons make it conductive. Watch the gate do it.

shots.title: 极薄绝缘层
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；用不同材质明确区分灰色硅、薄绝缘层、栅金属；切面描白边，不画成栅极开窗。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: A very thin insulator separates the gate from the silicon. The field acts through it, but any gate leakage into the silicon is normally tiny.

shots.title: 加电形成通道
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Now let's put a voltage on the gate. See? The electric field reaches through the insulator and pulls electrons in the silicon toward the insulating layer.

shots.title: 成通道再撤电
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_mechanism.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；本轮首帧采用统一纵向与横向结构示意；硅连续、绝缘层贴合、栅四面包围，载流子只在硅内；非实测尺寸。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: More and more electrons gather there and form a continuous channel. The two ends are connected.

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Now take the voltage away. The electrons spread out, the channel disappears, and it's off again.

shots.title: 结构不动与隔层追问
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；转入局部界面剖面模型 / Local interface cutaway；不作为整个环绕栅结构的全貌。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: The whole time, not one mechanical part moved. What changed was the electric field and where the electrons were.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Wait, there's an insulator in the way. The gate can't even touch those electrons, so how can it pull them over?

shots.title: 磁铁隔空类比
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: You know how a magnet can move iron filings even through a tabletop? It's pulling without touching them. Something similar is happening here, except this is an electric field, not a magnetic one.

shots.title: 看懂了
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...That's it? I thought there'd be some tiny hidden mechanism in there.

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: That's it. Enough positive voltage turns it on. Take it away, and it turns off.

shots.title: 为什么四面包住
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: It's wrapped up tightly on all four sides. Why go that far? Wouldn't covering one side be enough?

shots.title: 包围与漏电
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_mechanism.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；本轮首帧采用统一纵向与横向结构示意；硅连续、绝缘层贴合、栅四面包围，载流子只在硅内；非实测尺寸。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: The more the gate wraps, the better it usually controls the channel. Less current leaks when it's off, but off doesn't mean zero current. A tiny amount can get through.

shots.title: 平面到全包
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch3.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: That's why the design evolved from flat layers to upright fin channels, and now to gates wrapping all four sides.

shots.title: 点击到了
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；模型切换卡：平面器件局部示意 / Planar-device cutaway。蓝白仅为场/信号可视化，硅中蓝色底纹不作电子；若叠加电子，统一用琥珀色并保持在硅内。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Here it comes, that's my tap! ...But what does one switch turning on and off have to do with the photos and messages on my phone?

shots.title: 高低电压与零一
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: In a chip, high and low voltages often represent ones and zeros. Switches turn on and off to create and pass along these signals.

shots.title: 反相器
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；画出电源、地、互补 P/N 两管、共用输入与输出；高输入时 N 通 P 断、输出低，低输入相反。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Two different types of switches can work together as an inverter. A one becomes a zero, and a zero becomes a one. An inverter can't store photos by itself. Different circuits work together to make decisions, store photos, and play videos.

shots.title: 信号传向下一开关
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Your tap reaches the gate: the channel conducts, changing the output voltage. A wire carries that change to the next stage.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: So my tap really did make it all the way here... Found you.

shots.title: 数原子
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；P11错误旧图永久留档；本镜改为无人物的准确晶格示意，从构图上消除错腕和人体尺度冲突。；常驻：局部放大示意 / Magnified inset；此镜只标第一层至第五层，不提前揭晓总数。制作依据（不上屏）：[001] 厚约 6 nm，以晶格计算渲染，不拿 AI 点阵计数。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: One, two, three, four... five...

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: In this six-nanometer example, each sheet is only forty-something atomic layers thick. Engineers really can make silicon sheets this thin.

shots.title: 四十几层与并行制造
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch1.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；原子层统计沿 [001]，间距约 0.136 nm；不是原子直径。拉远回器件时关闭局部放大窗。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...Ten or twenty billion switches, made and wired together on a silicon slice.

shots.title: 猜缩小倍数
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图；人物仍约 100 nm 高；叠层高度须由模型决定。旧P12片间空槽已撤下；当前必须显示栅金属包围每片硅及片下方。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Guess how much smaller we are now.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Hmm... Ten thousand times? The dial only clicked a few times.

shots.title: 一千七百万倍
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图；后期：1.7 m ÷ 100 nm ≈ 1700 万；7.23 格（每格十倍）。镜头放大不改变人物尺寸。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Seven clicks and a bit, each making us ten times smaller. We're about 100 nanometers tall now, seventeen million times smaller than before.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Seventeen million?...

shots.title: 反向放大提问
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: What if we enlarged the chip seventeen million times too? Would each switch take up as much space as we do?

shots.title: 两个北京的面积
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch5.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；后期：比较的是面积；约 3.0–3.3 万 km² ≈ 1.8–2.0 个北京市行政区。平均地盘包含布线等面积，不是晶体管实体面积。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Yes. Each switch would take up just over a square meter on average. The chip would cover about twice Beijing's area. That's how a fingernail-sized slice holds ten or twenty billion switches.

shots.title: 两个北京揣兜里
shots.note: 首帧待出：本镜有独立机位，不再套用无关旧图

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Two Beijings... and I carry that around in my pocket every day?

shots.title: 回程
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Hold on. We're heading home.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: Woohoo, homeward bound!

shots.title: 凯讲回来
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_legacy.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: {Let me check. |}Below, ten or twenty billion switches have no moving parts. Electric fields control whether they conduct. Above, over a dozen wiring layers connect them like a city. It's all face-down inside that black package. Right?

shots.title: 下一期问题
shots.note: 首帧构图独立审查通过，绑定当前PNG；证据：edu_videos/tansuo/t01_inside_a_chip/reviews/codex_takeover_r1/frames_batch4.json。这不是动态成片或精确三维模型验收。；片尾补 AI 生成画面／AI 配音标注及来源卡；下一期：开关怎么组成加法。

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Exactly. You've got it.

lines.speaker: 阿凯
lines.text: ...But wait. If all they can do is turn on and off, how do they figure out that one plus one is two?

lines.speaker: 林工
lines.text: Ah, that's for next time. We'll head back in and find out.

Local cloned voices are for timing and listening review only.
